title.narrative: Investment Support to the Euro-Mediterranean University in Fez Projec

description.narrative: The main objective of this Project is to contribute to the delivery of modern higher education programs and research, focused both on international academic priorities and local industrial priorities, which will improve the supply of skills demanded on the local labour market. This will indeed contribute to bolster local employment for youth, by the improvement of young people's skills when entering the labour market in order to increase local employment for young graduates who suffer from a high rate of unemployment. More specifically, the Project will contribute to the creation of a more adequately educated workforce and thus, to the improvement of private sectors competitiveness in Morocco. The Project will also contribute to green industry development as well as mitigating climate change, by focusing on energy efficiency and using renewable energy on-site, along with the incorporation of various sustainable development tools and technologies, and by developing green engineering teaching and researches. Finally, the Project supports the UEMF in its ambitious Scholarship policy particularly favourable to students from low-income families.
